name: List my runner keys
description: Admin only, and scoped to the caller's OWN keys -- a key is a credential, and a route that returns more to some callers than others is the shape a privacy bug arrives in. The fleet view is GET /v1/runners, which is about machines rather than credentials. Returns key_prefix and never key_hash: the prefix exists so an operator can tell two keys apart before revoking one, and the hash is not a thing any caller has a use for. The runner count per key is what makes 'retire this one' an informed decision.
